title: A hidden limit of space and time could unlock electronics 100,000 times faster
caption:
Scientists just discovered a fundamental limit in how we track electrons. By measuring them at attosecond speeds, they found that timing and position are locked in a quantum trade-off.

Source: Sciencedaily - A hidden limit of space and time could unlock electronics 100,000 times faster

https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/11/261106174537.htm
